title: The Dream Subscription
joke: A man on the couch with a dusty dumbbell explains his unused gym pass is really a subscription to the dream.
caption:
Check the dumbbell in the corner. It has its own spider now.
Subscriptions we don't use often stay because cancelling feels like giving up on who we hoped to be.
Which subscription are you secretly keeping for the dream?
